title: Save Analysis Feature v3.0 - Simplified JSON Approach
description: Implement ability to save full analysis to backend API using simplified 2-field schema (term/pattern + details)

key_decisions: Save full analysis only (single 'Save Analysis' button, no inline saves)
Simplified schema: 2 fields per item (term/pattern + details)
Details field contains raw markdown (no parsing of individual fields)
Ruby syntax preservation is automatic (keep markdown as-is)
No local storage (backend API handles all persistence)
No UI for viewing saved items (separate application)
v3_benefits: 50% reduction in code (190 lines vs 400 lines)
More robust (simple splitting, no complex regex)

requirements.title: Save Full Analysis
requirements.description: Users can save the entire analysis (all words and grammar) with one click
acceptance_criteria: Single 'Save Analysis' button in prose-toolbar
Parses all vocabulary and grammar points from current analysis
Sends simplified JSON (2 fields per item) to backend API
Shows count of items saved (e.g., 'Saved 13 words, 2 grammar points!')
Visual confirmation when saved (success/error)

requirements.title: Simplified Markdown Parsing
requirements.description: Extract term/pattern from markdown, keep rest as raw details
acceptance_criteria: Extract vocabulary term (first line with Ruby tag: {kanji|reading})
Extract grammar pattern (first line: #### 1. 〜と (N3))
Capture everything else as raw markdown in 'details' field
Preserve Ruby syntax in term and details fields
Handle edge cases (missing sections, empty content)

requirements.title: Visual Feedback
requirements.description: Users receive clear visual feedback for save action
acceptance_criteria: Loading state shown during save operation
Success confirmation with checkmark/icon
Error notification with retry option

requirements.title: Ruby Syntax Preservation
requirements.description: Ruby tags {kanji|reading} must be preserved throughout
acceptance_criteria: Ruby tags preserved in vocabulary.term field
Ruby tags preserved in grammar_points.pattern field (if present)
Ruby tags preserved in details field (raw markdown)
No stripping or modification of Ruby syntax

v3_simplified.description: Only 2 fields per item - term/pattern + details

vocabulary_item.term: string (WITH Ruby: お{正月|しょうがつ} or {並|なら}ぶ)
vocabulary_item.details: string (Raw markdown with all info: accent, meaning, conjugations, etc.)

grammar_point.details: string (Raw markdown with all info: connection, explanation, examples, etc.)

vocabulary.details:
- 讀音：ならぶ
  - 重音：2
  - 動詞分類：五段動詞
  - 意思：排列、並列
  - 辭書形：{並|なら}ぶ
  - て形：{並|なら}んで
  - 否定形：{並|なら}ばない

grammar_points.details:
- **接續形式**
  - 動詞辭書形 + と
- **用法說明**
  - 表示當前項條件成立時，後項結果必然會發生...

save_analysis_button.location: In prose-toolbar, next to 'Save As' button

states.default: Outline bookmark icon, enabled when content loaded
states.success: Checkmark icon, green color, 'Saved!' (2s, then reverts)
states.error: X icon, red color, 'Failed' (stays until clicked again)

parsing_algorithm.key_insight: We DON'T parse the details! Just extract term/pattern, keep rest as-is

vocabulary_parsing.step_2: Split by double newlines to get word blocks
vocabulary_parsing.step_3: For each block: extract first line as term (Ruby tag)
vocabulary_parsing.step_4: Everything after first line is details (raw markdown)
vocabulary_parsing.code_example: const rubyMatch = firstLine.match(/\{(.+?)\|(.+?)\}/); const term = rubyMatch[0]; const details = lines.slice(1).join('\n');

grammar_parsing.step_2: Split by double newlines or '####' headers
grammar_parsing.step_3: For each block: first line is pattern header
grammar_parsing.step_4: Everything after first line is details (raw markdown)
grammar_parsing.code_example: if (firstLine.match(/^####\s*\d+\./)) { const pattern = firstLine; const details = lines.slice(1).join('\n'); }

ruby_preservation.automatic: By keeping details as raw markdown, Ruby is preserved automatically
ruby_preservation.no_special_handling: No need to track Ruby through multiple field transformations
ruby_preservation.example: Input: {並|なら}ぶ\n  - 辭書形：{並|なら}ぶ → Output: term: '{並|なら}ぶ}', details: '\n  - 辭書形：{並|なら}ぶ'
